You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important were new and improved weapons in the development of a war of attrition on the
Western Front? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Turkish resistance as a reason for Allied failure in the Gallipoli campaign?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important were Stresemann’s economic policies to the stability of the Weimar Republic,
1923-29? Explain your answer.
How significant were resistance groups in the opposition to Nazi rule? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was Russia’s continued involvement in the First World War as a reason for increased
support for the Bolsheviks between March and November 1917? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were gulags to Stalin’s system of control in the Soviet Union after 1928? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was government economic policy as a cause of prosperity in the USA in the 1920s?
Explain your answer.
How significant were problems in agriculture as an aspect of the Great Depression in the USA?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the Japanese invasion of China as a reason for increased support for the
Chinese Communist Party before 1949? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the treatment of landlords as an aspect of Mao’s land reforms in the 1950s?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was the PAC in determining the nature of resistance to apartheid in the 1950s and
1960s? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Desmond Tutu in ending white minority rule in South Africa? Explain your
answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was Jewish immigration as a cause of tension in the Middle East by 1948? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant were Israeli military tactics in determining the outcome of the Yom Kippur War,
1973? Explain your answer. [40]
